:::{#cor-conditional-entropy-difference}
#### Conditional entropy as a difference

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite entropies,

$$\entropyf{X \mid Y} = \entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{Y}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Subtract $\entropyf{Y}$ from both sides of @cor-entropy-chain-rule-reversed:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{Y}
&= \entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y} \\
&= \entropyf{X \mid Y}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
